growing_profile.observation: k is loaded before bounds checks so LLVM hoists it in appendInteger. Dynamic shifts, segment selection and remaining header reads still cost more than the previous per-type constant k; reserve removes growth allocations but does not erase these costs.

default_index_probe.method: Unreserved GrowingArray<Integer> with 1000000 items, stride 997 modulo 1000000; 21 alternating CPU-1 runs with 10000000 reads; Callgrind after the same 1000000 initial pushes and 100000 reads. Output matches both compilers and the arithmetic sum of ten permutations.
default_index_probe.linker: Both extra-probe executables use the same default system cc linker; LLVM 18 emits their code. The main four-row measurements and the 25 controls use CC=clang18.
